Description:
As an arrow whizzes past, narrowly grazing a strand of your hair and embedding itself in a nearby tree, a magical residue lingers in its wake. Eyes peeled for its source, you don't see where, but you know who: Elves. This was a warning shot.
Elves, tall and slender beings, embody an innate elegance that seems to flow through their every movement. They possess a discerning nature, categorizing their own tribes based on the environments they call home, and this comes with a prejudice that runs deep in their societies. Wood Elves, deeply attuned to the natural world, find solace amidst the verdant embrace of ancient forests. Hy Elves, on the other hand, thrive in the bustling energy of cities, harnessing their keen intellect and adaptability to flourish amidst the urban landscape. And in the depths beneath the earth, the Drough Elves navigate the hidden realms, where shadows and secrets intertwine.
Unlike most races, Elves do not sleep, but rather, they enter a meditative state to rejuvenate their spirits and minds. Deprived of the realm of dreams, their minds remain sharply focused on the present, always attuned to the world around them. This heightened awareness intertwines with their natural affinity for magic. Whether drawing upon the ancient forces of nature or delving into the depths of arcane arts, Elves possess an inherent connection to the mystical energies that course through the realms.
Language: You speak Common, Elvish and a number of chosen languages equal to your Intelligence or Charisma (whichever is higher).

~Meditation~.Effect:
As an Elf, your sleep is more akin to meditation and you only need 4 hours of sleep per night.
Elves don't dream and can still hear and smell while sleeping, but at a lower responsiveness.

~Gene Diversity~.Effect: When creating your Hero, choose 3 Elf Talents from below.

Starting Abilities Description.Meditation:
Elves are known for their strange sleeping patterns: their slumber is short, light, and dreamless. This leaves ample time during the day (or night) for the Elves to mind their business, engage in study, or prepare for a hunt. 
Long lives are often credited for their wise and clever individuals, though it's not clear what the lifespan of an Elf is. Some say centuries, while some claim some Elves don't reach even the lifespan of a mere human.

Starting Abilities Description.Gene Diversity:
Elven kingdoms span all across the lands and continents, and many of the subspecies of Elves have diverged into further branches, specializing in thriving in their environment. From the northern Aos Si Elves to the Dark Elves living underground, Elves are some of the most versatile inhabitants of Gaia.
Choose your heritage wisely, Elf.

~High Elf Ancestry~.Effect: You have access to Minor and Utility Wizard Talents up to your Level, no matter what Class you are.

~Moon Elf Ancestry~.Effect:
Silence a non-Epic Unit.
Learn which of its Stats are higher than yours.

~Purebreed~.Effect: Destroy a Magic Item equipment piece to permanently gain its Magic Item properties.
~Purebreed~.Notes: E.g. you disenchant Gloves of Athletics to permanently gain Skilled in Athletics, or you disenchant Gloves of Eldritch Blast to permanently gain the power to cast Eldritch Blast with a Half-Action once per Adventure.

Combat Extras: You can use bows and arrows with Stat Limit
~Wood Elf Ancestry~.Effect:
You have -1 Might, but +1 Movement Speed.
When using a Sword or Bow of any kind (except Sickle), you attack with your Stat Limit instead of that specific Stat.

~Dark Elf Ancestry~.Effect: You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Warlock Talents (ignoring the Evoke effects), up to your Level, no matter what Class you are.

~Aos Si Power~.Effect: Gain 1 Mana. You must spend it this Turn.
~Aos Si Power~.Upgrade: With fox ears, the tail of a squirrel or eyes of a cat, the Aos Si (pronounced Ees Shee) are a mythical type of elf with whimsical roots in the strange magic of the forest. The animal traits are said to resemble the personality of the Aos Si from birth, the animal features do not necessarily correspond to the parents'!

~Faey Heritage~.Effect: You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Druid Talents, up to your Level, no matter what Class you are.

Combat Extras: You can move through Enemy spaces
You can climb and ride on the back of an ally and move with them on their turn
~Thimble Kin~.Effect: You have -1 Might, but +1 Dexterity (up to the Level Limit). You can move through spaces of enemy Units. You can climb and ride on the back of an ally and move with them on their turn (without them having a Speed penalty). You are Small.
